description: This PHP class defines the 'Report' entity for the OrangeHRM application, mapping to the 'ohrm_report' database table. It includes properties like report ID, name, report group, filter usage, and type, along with corresponding getter and setter methods, and Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.
external_files: Doctrine ORM Mapping (use Doctrine\ORM\Mapping as ORM)

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Entity class representing a report, mapped to the 'ohrm_report' table with properties for report details and relationships.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the report.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the report.

methods.name: getReportGroup
methods.description: Returns the ReportGroup associated with this report.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Associates a ReportGroup with this report.

methods.name: isUseFilterField
methods.description: Indicates whether the report uses a filter field.

methods.name: setUseFilterField
methods.description: Sets whether the report uses a filter field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the report, if specified.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the report.
